goal: Alert callers to disk I/O errors and index corruption instead of reporting confirmed transactions as missing
Return descriptive errors when querying pruned or unavailable blocks instead of generic failures
agreement: Support for separating missing transactions from internal read and I/O failures (yuvicc, musaHaruna)
Resolved objection: pruned block queries returned misleading I/O errors instead of block unavailable (yuvicc)

categories.name: indexes
why: P3 because stops txindex lookups from masking disk I/O errors and index corruption as missing transactions
Properly reporting confirmed transactions during index failures is a deferrable corruption handling fix

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because distinguishes internal read failures from normal transaction not found errors in RPC callers
Ensures queries on pruned blocks return descriptive availability errors rather than generic failures
